title: Terms Tier Share of the Ship-To Move-Up Entry Gate
content:
The terms tier of the customer's Commercial Credit Account sets how much of the next level's entry gate applies when a Ship-To Fulfillment Account is moved up at the customer's request.

**Clause.** The next level's entry gate is applied at a share set by the terms tier of the customer's Commercial Credit Account: at 90 percent for a Corbett Net 60 Corporate Account or a Corbett Net 90 Strategic Account, at 94 percent for a Corbett Net 30 Preferred Account or a Corbett Net 45 Business Account, and in full for every other tier or where the customer has no such account.

| Terms tier of the Commercial Credit Account | Share of the gate applied |
|---|---|
| Corbett Net 60 Corporate Account | 90 percent |
| Corbett Net 90 Strategic Account | 90 percent |
| Corbett Net 30 Preferred Account | 94 percent |
| Corbett Net 45 Business Account | 94 percent |
| Corbett Net 10 Starter Account | in full |
| Corbett Net 30 Standard Account | in full |
| no Commercial Credit Account | in full |

The tier is the terms tier shown on the customer's Commercial Credit Account record.

*Hypothetical figure:* a next-level entry gate of 30000.00 applied at 90 percent is 27000.00.
